fusions.name: Unyielding Thrust
fusions.desc: A cold thrust that deals 28 damage, ignores armour, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Jaws Spring Shut
fusions.desc: Snaps shut around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Set the Jaws
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to set iron jaws by the nearest enemy. They stay armed for 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 3 tiles and everything within 2 tiles of the jaws take 16 damage.

fusions.name: Grim Persistence
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
